mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of periods where FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 8.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a weak labor market that triggers central bank intervention, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in the unemployment rate indicates a policy response to economic weakness, which typically precedes positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days as markets anticipate stimulus.
regime_hint: monetary policy response to labor weakness
failure_condition: The joint signal of FEDFUNDS decline and UNRATE rise fails to produce positive 20-day returns in 60% or more of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 750 thousand units (HOUST > 750), it signals robust demand for new homes, which typically precedes positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the housing sector is a leading indicator of economic health.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of periods where HOUST > 750.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 95.0 (INDPRO < 95.0) for two consecutive months indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as markets react to immediate economic deterioration.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in 60% or more of triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in residential sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand for housing, which typically drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the housing sector is a leading indicator of economic expansion.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of periods where RSAFS rises for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.0% (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%), it signals accelerating inflation that typically triggers negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns as markets anticipate central bank tightening.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in 60% or more of periods where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST > 750) and industrial production (INDPRO > 97.0) signals robust economic activity across multiple sectors, which typically precedes positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST > 750 and INDPRO > 97.0 fails to produce positive 60-day returns in 60% or more of cases.
